headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when gold changed shoulders as the AEW World Trios Titles found a new champion as House of Black vs. The Elite battled it out, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.63 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses. For House of Black, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. It was the 10th time the AEW World Trios Titles had been on the line, a notable milestone for the title. House of Black isolated Matt Jackson from his stablemates and hit Dante's Inferno to dethrone The Elite, becoming the third-ever AEW World Trios Champions.

Back on this day in 2022, Adam Page vs. Adam Cole put the AEW World Heavyweight Title on the line, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.27 ? a fantastic contest. For Adam Cole, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. A hard-fought main event between two Adams, settled only after Dark Order evened the odds and Page connected with the Buckshot Lariat, on the same card as CM Punk and MJF's brutal, bloody Dog Collar classic.
2025 brought us this moment: King & Strickland didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.24 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2023, MJF vs. Bryan Danielson clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title in an Iron Man (60 Minutes) match, appearing on Revolution, rated 9.63 ? a genuine masterpiece. MJF outlasted Danielson in a bloody 60-minute Iron Man Match, 4 falls to 3, in one of the most acclaimed championship matches in AEW history.

It was 2022 when Jurassic Express vs. reDRagon vs. The Young Bucks put the AEW World Tag Team Titles on the line, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.58 ? a genuine showstealer. For reDRagon, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. A tag team spectacle with real internal tension ? reDRagon and the Young Bucks' uneasy alliance kept cracking throughout, before Jurassic Express finally survived the three-way war to retain their titles.

2023 brought us this moment: there was a changing of the guard for the AEW TNT Title as Wardlow vs. Samoa Joe battled it out, appearing on Revolution, rated 5.16 ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. Wardlow attacked Joe the moment the bell rang, and the two traded hoss offense until Wardlow sunk in a rear naked choke to win his first TNT Championship.
